goalbuddy_receipt_v1.summary: Connected the web product to loopback-only governed Hindsight. Canonical approval always commits first; stable document IDs, strict scope tags and provenance drive idempotent projection, retry and reconciled recall. Projection failures and zero-unit extraction remain queued, while search falls back explicitly to active cited vault memory. The UI exposes engine and retry status. Mocked outage/retry/recall tests, 42 full tests, release and secret gates pass. A live local bank retained the document and exposed the current LLM provider failure safely.
deviations: The active pinned Hindsight API/database is healthy, but its current llamacpp provider cannot connect and extracts zero memory units. SuperMemory now detects this and refuses to mark the projection synced.
The delegated Worker produced no allowed-file changes in the GoalBuddy wait window; the PM completed the same bounded task as deterministic fallback.
remaining_blockers: Configure and prove a working local structured-output LLM provider for the pinned Hindsight runtime.
Implement folder-wide removal reconciliation and governed canonical/Hindsight deletion.
